tests.case: ignores callbacks queued by a removed card or disconnected observation generation
deduplicates the same release across shelves, reloads, and screen remounts for the UTC day

FeedViewModelTests.Viewport_notification.reason: The observer lifecycle tests reject detached and old-generation callbacks; the adjacent daily-ledger test asserts one release across shelves, reloads and remounts.

tests.case: waits for a modal to close and records a new UTC day only when the feed is exposed again

FeedImpressionTests.Reloads_and_history_.reason: The tests combine a retained document ledger across remounts with controlled UTC day rollover while an accessible modal covers the feed; closing it records exactly one new daily observation.

tests.case: suppresses %s windows and records still-visible cards on return

FeedImpressionTests.Hidden_feed_and_inac.reason: Document visibility and active-window gates are tested independently, alongside hidden/display/opacity/aria-hidden ancestor cases; revealing or focusing the still-intersecting card records it once.

tests.case: loads a new pass and scrolls to unseen cards while hidden without recording until the window returns

FeedImpressionTests.Hidden_window_can_lo.reason: Observer callbacks arriving while the document is hidden create no record; returning to a visible focused window exposes the card. The same component uses this single document observer for new and scrolled cards.
